shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat vertical surface
curved linear incised form (possibly a horn or crescent) in A; curved patterned masses in B
justification: A shows only a faint, schematic curved incised line (possibly an animal's horn or a crescent-like shape) with a small rectangular block on a framed panel, while B shows a highly detailed human head in profile with an elaborately coiled beard and hair and a fluted headdress. Beyond both being shallow relief on a flat panel, there is no shared motif, relationship or arrangement, and the conventions differ utterly: bare linear incision versus dense, repeated spiral curl patterning and naturalistic facial modelling.
